info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Sites API
info.description:
Manage Experience Cloud sites, themes, and configurations. Provides programmatic access to create, update, and retrieve site settings, branding, and navigation for digital experience portals. Part of the Salesforce Connect REST API.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support

request.description: Publishes the specified Experience Cloud site, making all pending changes live. Requires the Create and Set Up Experiences permission.
